title: Do we have to accept Quantum weirdness? De Broglie Bohm Pilot Wave Theory explained
summary: Looking Glass Universe explains de Broglie-Bohm pilot wave theory (Bohmian mechanics) as an alternative to the standard interpretation of quantum mechanics. The video lays out the pros and cons of the theory and links to related videos on contextuality and entanglement.
why: HN commenters recommend the channel as a clear, well-made source on quantum mechanics and common misconceptions about Bohmian mechanics.

quote.text: I love this series, Looking Glass Universe, on the subject [0,1].
